def prepare_mac_header(token, uri, key, http_method, nonce=None, headers=
    None, body=None, ext='', hash_algorithm='hmac-sha-1', issue_time=None,
    draft=0):
    """
    Prepare a MAC Authorization header.
    
    :param token: The access token
    :param uri: The request URI
    :param key: The MAC key
    :param http_method: The HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.)
    :param nonce: Optional nonce, generated if not provided
    :param headers: Optional headers dict
    :param body: Optional request body
    :param ext: Optional extension string
    :param hash_algorithm: Hash algorithm to use (default: hmac-sha-1)
    :param issue_time: Optional token issue time for age calculation
    :param draft: Draft version (0 or 1)
    :return: Authorization header value
    """
    headers = headers or {}
    
    # Generate nonce if not provided
    if nonce is None:
        nonce = common.generate_nonce()
    
    # Generate timestamp
    ts = common.generate_timestamp()
    
    # Parse the URI
    parsed_uri = urlparse(uri)
    
    # Construct the normalized request string
    # Format: HTTP_METHOD\nREQUEST_URI\nHOST\nPORT\n[BODY_HASH\n]EXT\nTIMESTAMP\nNONCE\n
    
    host = parsed_uri.hostname
    port = parsed_uri.port
    
    # Determine port
    if port is None:
        port = 443 if parsed_uri.scheme == 'https' else 80
    
    # Build request path with query string
    request_path = parsed_uri.path
    if parsed_uri.query:
        request_path = request_path + '?' + parsed_uri.query
    
    # Calculate body hash if body is provided
    body_hash = ''
    if body:
        if hash_algorithm == 'hmac-sha-1':
            body_hash = b2a_base64(hashlib.sha1(body.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(body, str) else body).digest()).decode('utf-8').rstrip('\n')
        elif hash_algorithm == 'hmac-sha-256':
            body_hash = b2a_base64(hashlib.sha256(body.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(body, str) else body).digest()).decode('utf-8').rstrip('\n')
    
    # Build the signature base string
    if draft == 0:
        # Draft 0 format
        signature_base_string = '\n'.join([
            http_method.upper(),
            request_path,
            host,
            str(port),
            body_hash if body_hash else '',
            ext,
            ts,
            nonce,
            ''
        ])
    else:
        # Draft 1 format
        signature_base_string = '\n'.join([
            http_method.upper(),
            request_path,
            host,
            str(port),
            body_hash if body_hash else '',
            ext,
            ts,
            nonce,
            ''
        ])
    
    # Calculate MAC signature
    if hash_algorithm == 'hmac-sha-1':
        mac = b2a_base64(hmac.new(
            key.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(key, str) else key,
            signature_base_string.encode('utf-8'),
            hashlib.sha1
        ).digest()).decode('utf-8').rstrip('\n')
    elif hash_algorithm == 'hmac-sha-256':
        mac = b2a_base64(hmac.new(
            key.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(key, str) else key,
            signature_base_string.encode('utf-8'),
            hashlib.sha256
        ).digest()).decode('utf-8').rstrip('\n')
    else:
        mac = b2a_base64(hmac.new(
            key.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(key, str) else key,
            signature_base_string.encode('utf-8'),
            hashlib.sha1
        ).digest()).decode('utf-8').rstrip('\n')
    
    # Build the Authorization header
    auth_header = 'MAC id="%s", nonce="%s", ts="%s", mac="%s"' % (token, nonce, ts, mac)
    
    if body_hash:
        auth_header = 'MAC id="%s", nonce="%s", bodyhash="%s", ts="%s", mac="%s"' % (token, nonce, body_hash, ts, mac)
    
    if ext:
        auth_header = 'MAC id="%s", nonce="%s", ts="%s", mac="%s", ext="%s"' % (token, nonce, ts, mac, ext)
    
    if body_hash and ext:
        auth_header = 'MAC id="%s", nonce="%s", bodyhash="%s", ts="%s", mac="%s", ext="%s"' % (token, nonce, body_hash, ts, mac, ext)
    
    return auth_header
